findings.issue: No closed shape/type/enum guard before classifier consumption. Unknown fields/protocol/issuer/ordinal, absent document_raw, string booleans and mismatched Ready receipt identity can still report VerifiedPublished.
findings.next: Owner-confirm exact candidate closed types; add independent negative vectors before document mutation. These are document oracle defects, not production corruption evidence.

limits: Issuer trust, held native lease and native atomicity are fixture premises, not runtime proof.
FileCommitReceipt has target_path/previous_digest/committed_digest/transaction_id, no native lease or Ready issuer. No staged rename or journal move authority.
State/deferred probes call pure classifier only: no modeled marker mutation, Ready state, no-replace IO, retry/cleanup or inherited approval is behaviorally proven.
Board management changes are separate from 796 product inventory; board source binding is checked separately.
